meta.title: World Scale, Streaming & Technical Planning
meta.description: Compressed Earth-inspired world scale with chunk-based streaming, LOD philosophy, modular asset workflow, terrain layers, performance budgets, and long-term expansion strategy.

world_scale.rationale: Feels large but practical for a solo creator. 1:1 Earth is far too large; a small sandbox lacks exploration.
world_scale.scale_description: 1 game meter = 100 real meters. A real 10km city becomes 100m in-game, walkable in ~1 minute.
world_scale.note: 1 Godot Unit = 1 Meter. Streaming uses 256m chunks; regions group 4x4 chunks (1024m).

levels.name: Chunk
levels.description: 256m x 256m streaming units. Loaded/unloaded based on player proximity.

hierarchy.streaming_rule: Only nearby chunks are loaded while distant chunks are unloaded. Game state is preserved when unloading.

chunk_system.threading: WorkerThreadPool for terrain generation and scene instantiation

lod.philosophy: Nearby objects use detailed models. Mid-distance objects use simplified models. Far objects use very low-detail or billboards.

levels.name: ultra
levels.description: Full detail, all materials, high-poly meshes.

asset_reuse.philosophy: A solo creator cannot build millions of unique objects. Use modular kits combined differently for variety.

modular_kits.description: Modular wall, floor, roof, door, window pieces combined into varied structures.
Straight, curve, intersection, bridge segments snapped together.
Reusable chairs, tables, beds, shelves placed across interiors.
Tree, bush, grass, rock variants with random rotation/scale.
Pole + lamp variants placed procedurally along roads.
Trash cans, benches, fire hydrants, mailboxes reused in districts.

terrain_layers.philosophy: Separate terrain into layers to make editing easier and streaming more efficient.

performance_budgets.philosophy: Define budgets early to prevent performance problems as the world grows.

budgets.description: Maximum concurrent NPCs in one district.
Maximum concurrent NPCs across all loaded chunks.
Maximum vehicles on roads in loaded area.
Soft target for draw calls per frame.
Soft target for texture VRAM usage.

data_driven_design.philosophy: Store game content as data rather than hardcoding it. Makes future updates easier.

free_resources.philosophy: Rely on free resources and communities to reduce workload.

resources.name: Godot Engine Documentation
resources.use: Official guides for scenes, resources, world streaming.

resources.name: OpenStreetMap
resources.use: Inspiration for road layouts and city planning.

resources.name: Kenney
resources.use: Free game assets and UI elements.

version_plan.philosophy: Grow the game in layers. Future updates add countries/continents without redesigning core systems.

streaming_technical.description: Chunks load when player enters load radius (512m) and unload when beyond unload radius (768m). Hysteresis prevents thrashing at boundaries. State is serialized to cache before unload.
